answer: Treat each whisper as one clone and canyon as the sole roll that keys a birth hash to one sponsor root; equal hashes meet there. Roots split from deep records one per epoch, and under one root canyon seals one judged receipt per epoch: receipt k must extend k-1 and burn k pearl into that whisper. Raising n whisper to depth m needs nm queued epochs and n·m(m+1)/2 pearl, unreusable across roots. It fails if canyon merges loosely, judges replay work, roots shard, or pearl moves.
